messages:
IncidentBot: P1 alert -> routing instability: policy-evaluator workers crashing, clients seeing 503/504. See /var/log/policy-engine/2026/err.log
Irene K: I have the page, paging oncall. Spike starts ~2026-03-15T08:06:30Z. Observed repeated cross-region retries (us-west -> eu-west -> us-west).
Matt R: Acknowledged. Is this affecting hosted API only or also Dedicated?
Irene K: Mostly public v2 generate endpoints. One Dedicated tenant filed a ticket reporting intermittent timeouts. Overall 5xx ~9% over 5m.
Alex P: Looking at stack traces: evaluator panics with "nil pointer deref" when executing `region_lookup(user.meta.region).priority`. The policy assumed region present. Example rule that hit it:
```
rule select_low_latency {
  when request.kind == "generate" && region_lookup(user.meta.region).priority > 0.5 {
    route = pick_variant("fast-quant")
  }
}
```
Jordan L: I repro locally by sending payloads without `user.meta.region`. Worker process exits, k8s restarts it. The restart causes router to treat cluster as degraded and to failover to next region, which triggers the same policy evaluation there -> loop.
Matt R: Customer impact: multiple customers experienced elevated errors and higher p95. No PII exposure. This is P1 due to production outages.
Irene K: Immediate mitigations to take now:
- flip feature flag `features.routing_policies=false` to stop policy evals
- push gateway override to force `variant=stable-baseline` for /v2/generate
- prepare a safe patch for the evaluator to short-circuit on missing attrs
Alex P: I'll flip the flag and push a tiny patch that wraps evaluation in recover() and returns false when a panic occurs. Also add guard for missing `user.meta.region` to return a sentinel with zero priority.
Irene K: Action: admin toggle `features.routing_policies=false` applied to clusters (us-west, eu-west, ap-south).
PolicyBot: Feature toggle recorded: features.routing_policies=false; rollout to 3 clusters completed in 15s.
Jordan L: After toggle, 5xx rate dropped from ~9% to ~1.1% within 2 minutes. P95 latency stabilizing.
Sophia M: Notifying CSM/Product: some customers may have experienced degraded routing/quality during the incident. Drafting an interim note.
Matt R: Good. Alex, plan for patch + rollout?
Alex P: Plan:
1) Add nil-safe accessor: `safe_region = user.meta.region ?: ""` and have `region_lookup("")` return empty struct.
2) Surround rule eval with `defer func(){ if r := recover(); r!=nil {metrics.Emit("policy_eval_panic"); return false}}()`
3) Add unit tests for missing fields and malformed user payloads.
ETA: canary in ~1.5h, full roll after smoke checks.
Jordan L: I'll instrument `policy_eval_panic` metric with labels `rule_id` and `cluster` and add an alert threshold.
SupportAgent: Support ticket #19844 asking for ETA; reply recommended: issue mitigated via routing toggle, patch deploying to canary, ETA ~2h for fix, will follow up.
Irene K: Handing off incident lead to Matt for postmortem and communications. Alex will own code fix.
Matt R: Taking lead. I'll assemble timeline and own the postmortem. Please keep this thread updated.
Alex P: Canary deploy to us-west-canary at +1h20m. No panics in canary logs. Proceeding to roll.
PolicyBot: Deploy success: policy-engine v1.12.4-hotfix rolled to clusters at +2h05m.
Jordan L: Observability: `policy_eval_panic` count -> 0 after deploy, routing 5xx back to baseline.
Sophia M: Sent interim customer messages via CSM.
Irene K: Severity downgraded P1 -> P2 after validation. Postmortem owner: Matt R.
Matt R: Creating action items:
- A1: Harden DSL accessors (Alex P)
- A2: Add unit & integration tests for missing attributes (Alex P)
- A3: Emit and alert on `policy_eval_panic` (Jordan L)
- A4: Add gating on policy-engine restarts to prevent immediate cluster failover (Irene K)
- A5: Customer follow-up + postmortem publication (Sophia M / Matt R)
Irene K: Thanks team. Leaving thread open until postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
